name: Sweet Devil
source:
Mao-kun has become lost in the demon world. The ones who came to help me, as puzzled as I was, were none other than 2 demons! "Sweet Devil" is a shota dice adventure game.

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE035969.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
毛坤在魔界迷失了方向。和我一样疑惑的来救我的，正是两只恶魔！《甜蜜恶魔》是一款正太骰子冒险游戏。

[来自[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE035969.html]DLsite英文[/url]]
